result:
`billingUrl` is now `billingEndpoint` everywhere, and all four changes are merged with CD green. I did not inspect the live CDN bundles to confirm `billingUrl` is gone. I'm relying on the green CD runs and the local builds.

| PR | Repo | Change |
|---|---|---|
| #1 | `libs-shared-contracts` | Renamed `billingUrl` to `billingEndpoint` with the same value, and bumped the version to 2.0.0 (major, since it's breaking). The registry now has 1.0.0 and 2.0.0. |
| #2 | `apps-sub-route-billing` | Switched to `billingEndpoint` and `@mfe/shared-contracts@^2.0.0`. |
| #3 | `apps-core-shell` | Same change as #2. |
| #4 | `apps-sub-route-reports` | Same change as #2. |

I built each app locally, and `grep -rn billingUrl` returns nothing in the three apps and the contracts repo. I checked the grep before the commit, excluding `node_modules`, `.git` and `dist`.

The reports app was not a sub-task on the ticket, but it also read `billingUrl`. Left alone, it would have broken the next time it was rebuilt against 2.0.0, and the acceptance criteria cover every app that used it. So I opened PR #4 for it.

Nothing else slowed me down.
